accueil.associationNotePart1: Running an association? A single plan at €19/month, 1-month free trial —

aPropos.p1: UniGest was born from a simple observation: running a small business or an association - quotes, invoices, membership dues, basic bookkeeping - still often relies on makeshift spreadsheets or tools built for large organizations, too heavy for a sole trader, a small business or a small association.
aPropos.p2: For businesses, we're building a platform that handles the full document chain - from quote to invoice, through purchase orders, delivery notes, deposit invoices and credit notes - in line with French and European invoicing rules: gapless sequential numbering, mandatory legal notices, VAT exemption handling (art. 293 B of the French tax code), late payment penalties.
aPropos.p3: On top of that, simplified bookkeeping: revenue entries are generated automatically when an invoice is marked paid, expenses are logged in a few clicks, and a dashboard gives a clear view of the balance and monthly activity - without turning the user into an accountant.
aPropos.p4: A French non-profit association can choose this same account at signup: member management with status tracking, membership dues with automatic receipt generation, meeting organisation with sign-ups and attendance tracking, donations and grants, a projected budget compared against actuals, and a dedicated financial report. A single plan, no tiers, giving access to every feature once the subscription is active - with a one-month free trial, just like a business account.
aPropos.p5: Several people can manage the same association account, each with a role that matches their responsibilities - president, treasurer, communications or secretary - so everyone only sees what concerns them. Announcements are emailed to every active member, and important documents (bylaws, internal rules, meeting minutes, activity reports) are kept in a dedicated archive, sorted by category.
aPropos.p6: UniGest already generates invoices in the Factur-X format (PDF/A-3 with embedded CII XML), one of the e-invoicing formats recognised by the French tax authority. Transmission through a Partner Dematerialisation Platform (PDP), required for the full business-to-business e-invoicing reform, is part of our roadmap.

legalConfidentialite.intro: This policy describes how UniGest collects, uses, and protects personal data processed as part of the Service, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act (loi Informatique et Libertés).
legalConfidentialite.s1Corps: To be completed before commercial launch: company name, legal form, address, and contact email of the UniGest publisher, acting as data controller within the meaning of the GDPR.
legalConfidentialite.s2Item1Reste: : last name, first name, email, password (hashed, never stored in plain text).
legalConfidentialite.s2Item2Reste: : company name, SIRET or RNA number, address, VAT regime where applicable, bank details (IBAN/BIC) if provided, logo.
legalConfidentialite.s2Item3Reste: : information about a business's clients or an association's members (name, address, email, phone, SIRET number where applicable), and about related documents or activity (invoices, membership dues, donations).
legalConfidentialite.s2Item4Reste: : IP address (used only to limit login attempts), and technical logs necessary for the operation and security of the Service.
legalConfidentialite.s2Corps: UniGest does not install any advertising or tracking cookies. Only a session cookie, strictly necessary for authentication, is used.
legalConfidentialite.s3Item1: Provision of the Service (performance of the contract);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item2: Issuance of business documents compliant with French regulations (legal obligation);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item3: Security of the Service and fraud prevention (legitimate interest);
legalConfidentialite.s3Item4: Billing of the subscription for paid plans (performance of the contract).
legalConfidentialite.s4Corps: Account data is retained for as long as the account is active. Business documents (quotes, invoices, credit notes) are retained in accordance with legal requirements for retaining accounting and business records under French law (in principle 10 years from the end of the financial year, article L123-22 of the French Commercial Code), even after account deletion where required by law.
legalConfidentialite.s5Intro: Data is hosted and processed by the following providers, as part of their respective roles:
legalConfidentialite.s5Item2: Database: Supabase, on AWS infrastructure in the Europe region (Paris, eu-west-3);
legalConfidentialite.s5Item3: Subscription payments: Stripe, when card payment is used;
legalConfidentialite.s5Item4: Transactional emails (password reset): Resend, when configured.
legalConfidentialite.s5Corps: No data is sold to third parties or used for advertising purposes.
legalConfidentialite.s6Part1: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object with respect to your data. The right to rectification and access to your data can be exercised directly from your workspace (Company, Clients pages). The right to erasure can be exercised immediately and without any formality from the "danger zone" on the Company page, which permanently deletes your account and all your data (subject to the legal retention obligations mentioned in section 4). For any other request, contact us at the address given in the
legalConfidentialite.s6Corps2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority (Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés, CNIL), www.cnil.fr.
legalConfidentialite.s7Corps: Passwords are hashed (bcrypt), connections to the Service are encrypted (HTTPS), and each company's data access is strictly isolated at the application level. Login attempts are rate-limited to prevent brute-force attacks.
legalConfidentialite.s2CorpsAudience: Pages on the public site (home, about, pricing, legal pages) are measured with a strictly anonymous, self-hosted analytics system with no third-party provider: only the path visited and the referring site's domain are recorded, with no cookie, no IP address, and no identifier that could link two visits together.

villeLyon.surtitre: Business management in Lyon and the Rhône region
villeLyon.titre: The invoicing and management software for businesses in Lyon
villeLyon.intro: UniGest is published by QbelyTech, a company based in Vaulx-en-Velin, in the heart of the Lyon metropolitan area. Built with and for freelancers, tradespeople and small businesses in the Rhône-Alpes region, it brings quotes, invoices and accounting together in a single tool, with nothing to install.
villeLyon.p1: Across Lyon, Villeurbanne, Vaulx-en-Velin and the wider metropolitan area, freelancers and small businesses often juggle several tools (spreadsheets, Word templates, separate accounting software) to manage quotes and invoices. UniGest brings this entire document chain together in a single application, accessible from any browser, with nothing to install.
villeLyon.p2: Every document (quote, purchase order, delivery note, invoice) follows French and European legal requirements, with sequential numbering and an invoice that becomes unalterable as soon as it is issued - a requirement under article 286-I-3° bis of the French tax code, which applies to businesses in the region as everywhere in France.
villeLyon.p3: Data is hosted in Europe (Paris region) and backed up daily. No credit card is required to get started: the free plan lets you try the tool before moving to a higher plan as your business grows.
villeLyon.avantagesTitre: Built for freelancers and small businesses in the region

q1.question: Is UniGest suitable for sole traders in Lyon?
q1.reponse: Yes, the free plan is designed to get started with no commitment and no credit card, and covers the needs of a sole trader or small business: quotes, invoices and expense tracking.

q2.question: Do I need to be based in Lyon to use UniGest?
q2.reponse: No, UniGest is an online application usable anywhere in France. QbelyTech, the publisher, is based in Vaulx-en-Velin, but the software is aimed at all French businesses.

q3.question: Are the generated invoices legally compliant?
q3.reponse: Yes: mandatory legal information, sequential numbering and immutability upon issue, in accordance with article 286-I-3° bis of the French tax code.

villeParis.titre: Quotes, invoices and accounting for businesses in Paris
villeParis.intro: Between overheads, competition and administrative requirements, freelancers and small businesses in Île-de-France need reliable tools without wasting time on setup. UniGest brings quotes, invoices and accounting together in an online application, accessible from anywhere in seconds.
villeParis.p1: In Paris, as across the rest of Île-de-France, the density of freelancers and small businesses makes administrative work time-consuming: quotes that need to go out fast to avoid losing a client, invoices that must be error-free, expense tracking for VAT or tax returns. UniGest centralises this entire document chain in a single tool.
villeParis.p2: Every document (quote, purchase order, delivery note, invoice) follows French and European legal requirements. Once issued, an invoice becomes unalterable - in accordance with article 286-I-3° bis of the French tax code - and any correction goes through a credit note, without ever modifying the original document.
villeParis.p3: Data is hosted in Europe (Paris region) and backed up automatically every day. The free plan requires no credit card: you can try the tool before moving to a higher plan as your business grows.
villeParis.avantagesTitre: Built for freelancers, SMEs and businesses across Île-de-France
